284054751.description:
Natural Petrified Wood Specimen
Fossilized Wood Slab Display Piece
Mineralized Stone, Approximately 8 x 5.4 Inches
This authentic petrified wood specimen exhibits preserved organic cellular structure transformed into silica over millions of years. Featuring distinct linear grain patterns and earthy color zoning from rich deep brown to golden tan and subtle grayish-blue hues, this piece makes a striking natural display or lapidary specimen. It represents an exceptional example of geological permineralization, highly appreciated by rock, mineral, and fossil collectors.
Natural petrified wood showing clear linear grain and bark-like outer texture
Earthy color palette with banded amber, chocolate brown, tan, and cool gray tones
Natural rough fracture surfaces and stepped slab formation
Measures approximately 8 inches long by 5.4 inches wide and 1 inch thick
Condition:
Natural geological specimen in raw, unpolished state. Features authentic rough edges, natural fractures, surface pits, and organic textural variations inherent to mineralized fossil wood. Structurally solid with no signs of artificial repair or stabilization.
